name: Field
purpose: Visually arrange one control with its label, description, error, and inherited Atom field relationships.
useWhen: One finished control needs a visible label and may need help or error text.

avoidWhen.condition: Several related controls share one group label.
avoidWhen.useInstead: Fieldset, with Field inside when individual controls also need labels

composition: Compose Field.Root -> Field.Label -> one control -> optional Field.Description -> optional Field.Error.

rules.statement: Associate one Field with one control.
Field.Label already renders the default required marker; never add a second asterisk or RequiredIndicator unless the default is disabled.
Load styles.css or core.css plus field.css and the owned control stylesheet.

commonMistakes.mistake: Adding a manual required asterisk beside a required Field.Label.
commonMistakes.correction: Set required on Field.Root and use the built-in Label marker, or explicitly replace it once.

validation: Confirm label, description, and error relationships.
Check vertical and horizontal layouts at narrow widths.
